title: Shabbir aa rahe hai
body:
SHABEER AA RAHE JANZA LEYE HUWE
ANKHON ME APNE ASHKO KA DARIYA LEYE HUWE
LASHAN JAWAN PISAR KA HAI ABBAS BHI NAHI
SHABBER RO RAHEN HAI YE SADMA LIYE HUWE
ZAINAB SABHALO LAILA KO AKBAR GUZAR GAE
MAI AA RAHA HOON USKA HI LASHA LIYE HUWE
AAYE NA GHAR ME BYAH KE AKBAR TERI DULHAN
ROTI HAI MAAN UMMIDON KA SEHRA LIYE HUWE
AKBAR HAMARA PYASA HI DUNIYA SE CHAL BASA
SHABBER RO RAHE HAI YE SHIKWA LIYE HUWE
BARCHI NIKAL TO AEE HAI SEENE SE LAL KE
LEKIN ANI KE SATH KALEJA LEYE HUWE
LAILA PACHADE KHATI HAI AKBAR KO DEKH KAR
DAR HAI GUZAR NA JAI YE SADMA LIYE HUWE
HAR HAR QADAM THOKAREN KHATE HAIN BAR BAR
ATHHARA SAL WALE KA LASHA LIYE HUWE
PEERI WA JAOF AUR NIKAHAT KE BAWAJOOD
MAYYAT HAI TEEN ROZ KA PYASA LEYE HUWE
DEKHA ALAM TO SAMJHI KI PANI BHI AAGAYA
BALI SAKINA AA GAI KUZA LIYE HUWE
ASGHAR KO DAFN KARKE JUN HI SHAIH KHADE HUWE
QASID BHI AA GAYA KAHA TE SUGHRA LEYE HUWE
NAZREN TALASH KARTI THI QASID KI BAR BAR
SHABBER BAITHEN HONGE EK BACHCHA LYE HUWE
SHAH KA QAMAR TO SO GAYA KHAKE SENA MAGAR
PANI KI. EK BOOND KA SHIKWA LIYE HUWE
